summary_rationale: Intuitive Surgical operates an entrenched installed-base surgical robotics ecosystem with 12,094 da Vinci systems, 1,152 Ion systems, and newly FDA-cleared IG1000 GI endoluminal tech (K253702) as of September 30, 2026, generating 84%–85% recurring revenue ($7.39B in 9M 2026) from encrypted instruments, service contracts, and operating leases (53.3% of Q3 placements). Across FY2016–FY2025, sales compounded at +15.7% to $10.06B, and 9M 2026 delivered $2.42B GAAP EBIT (27.8% margin after the $450M settlement) and $2.87B free cash flow on a debt-free balance sheet ($6.80B cash/investments after $4.42B in buybacks and the $533.1M Southern Europe distributor buyout) with 18.5% ROIC. It retains COMPOUNDER_PASS, while KPI health stays PASS_WITH_WATCH on six verified risks: U.S. da Vinci growth cooling to ~10% (low double-digit U.S. bariatric decline), U.S. Ion penetration passing 50%, Medtronic Hugo (K250725) and J&J OTTAVA (DEN250068) FDA clearances, the Ninth Circuit SIS antitrust reversal alongside the $450M settlement, Q4 2026 China NHSA plus 1H 2027 extended-use instrument price cuts (-3% to -5% I&A/case), and Section 301 tariffs plus Mexicali FDA uninspected border-hold exposure.
